residual_risks: This task qualifies disposable SPIRE server/agent provisioning and SVID delivery only; OCOR-DEV-0021 authorization, outage, stale-policy and latency semantics remain unqualified.
Join-token node attestation is intentionally non-reattestable; deterministic recovery rotates a short-lived token, recreates only the disposable agent and prunes superseded registrations.
The development Compose profile runs the SPIRE agent as the upstream image default user; workload isolation and production hardening remain subject to the dedicated security campaign.
rollback: The executed rollback path paused and unpaused only the disposable SPIRE agent. Credential recovery recreated only that agent, pruned superseded registrations, removed the temporary workload entry and left exactly one healthy agent; no adjacent service or production state was targeted.
